messages:
Asha (CS Ops): heads-up — noticed a spike in accounts moving to L2 health without any recent touchpoints. suspect a scoring regression after last week's ingest change.
Tom (Enablement): ugh, thanks for flagging. is it narrow or across many accounts?
Asha (CS Ops): looks concentrated to a handful of pilots and new-onboard cohorts — about ~320 accounts. distribution skewed in 'activation' bucket.
Luis (CRM): could be mapping change from the new contact dedupe. i ran a quick query, seems last_contact_ts flipped for some records.
Riley (Data): can you paste the SQL you used? i'll run it against staging.
Luis (CRM): sure —
Luis (CRM): ```sql
select account_id, last_contact_ts, health_score_v2, source
from accounts
where updated_at > now() - interval '7 days'
and health_score_v2 between 20 and 40
order by updated_at desc
limit 500;
```
Asha (CS Ops): thanks. i want to avoid a full playbook rollback until we confirm root cause. proposal: a light-touch safeguard — sample 10% of affected accounts, pause their auto-health updates, and queue manual review for those above a renew-risk threshold.
Tom (Enablement): Agree. That reduces customer impact and gives CS time to triage.
playbook-bot: created safeguard run id rp-688001 — status: queued. (/playbooks/safeguard-run rp-688001) :gear:
Luis (CRM): i updated the mapping patch to add a defensive check for missing contact provenance. will push to staging after Riley signs off.
Riley (Data): running the sample check now. will confirm whether the last_contact_ts comes from legacy ingest or webhook duplicates.
Asha (CS Ops): for the manual queue, suggest tags: "safeguard:sampled", "triage:renewal-risk" so CS can filter. also enable a one-week hold on auto-email nudges for those accounts.
Tom (Enablement): can the console flag be a temporary toggle? i don't want ops to run a manual SQL every time.
Luis (CRM): yes — added a route in admin: `healthscore.safeguard_pause=true` scoped to rollout id rp-688001. i'll include a tiny runbook snippet: 
Luis (CRM): ```yaml
run_id: rp-688001
scope: accounts_sampled
actions:
  - pause_health_updates: true
  - add_tags: [safeguard:sampled, triage:renewal-risk]
  - notify: cs-team
```
Asha (CS Ops): perfect. once Riley confirms the source, i'll kick the sample triage and surface 30 accounts to owners for quick contact attempts.
Riley (Data): sample looks like 78% are webhook duplicates, 22% legacy import. will post full breakdown in an hour.
Tom (Enablement): if webhook duplicates are the culprit, we should add a guard so duplicate webhooks don't overwrite last_contact_ts with older timestamps.
Luis (CRM): noted. i'll add a timestamp-checking guard in the mapping: only apply contact update if incoming_ts >= existing_last_contact_ts.
playbook-bot: rp-688001 moved to in-progress — safeguard enacted for sampled cohort. :white_check_mark:
Asha (CS Ops): thanks team. next steps: Riley posts breakdown, Luis patches mapping (+ staging test), Tom prepares short CS playbook for manual outreach, and i'll coordinate the 10% triage tomorrow morning.
Tom (Enablement): i'll draft a 3-bullet outreach template and post it here.
Asha (CS Ops): awesome — tagging this thread for follow-up: @channel — will update when we finish the sample review.
